create_xy_grid: create a pixel coordinate grid of shape HxWx2 for numpy or torch tensors
apply_geometric_transform: apply a homography or projection matrix to transform 3D points with optional normalization
convert_depthmap_to_pts3d: convert a depth map and pseudo focal length into a 3D pointmap of absolute coordinates
normalize_pointcloud: normalize two point clouds together using average distance, median, or sqrt normalization modes
find_reciprocal_matches: find reciprocal nearest neighbor matches between two point sets using a KDTree
